name: TextCursor-TS-TW
title: Text Cursor Trail
description: Moving the pointer inside a rounded dark panel scatters copies of a chosen glyph along its path, each drifting and twisting slightly before fading. Only the most recent handful of marks stay on screen.
use: A playful hero or showcase panel should reward moving the pointer around.
avoid: Touch devices: there is no pointer to leave a trail, so nothing appears.
a11y: The trail is pointer-only and its glyph nodes are not hidden from screen readers; no reduced-motion handling. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide rounded panel, a shade lighter than the black stage, holds a centred white star glyph above the bold heading "Text Cursor" and a small muted hint line.
behaves: As the pointer moves, copies of the glyph appear at fixed gaps along its path, turned to face the direction of travel and wobbling gently. Older marks fade and shrink away so only the newest few remain.
customise: The glyph, spacing, maximum marks, float wobble and exit duration are props. Colours and text sizes come from surrounding classes.
weight: light: At most a handful of looping glyph elements exist at once.
demo: Heading "Text Cursor" with the hint "Move your cursor here to leave a trail of floating glyphs".
polishWhy: Soft panel, tidy centring and a charming trail; the glyphs are quite small and sparse.
